# Credits and third-party licenses

Ariadne is developed by ChipsAhoyMcCoy. Terraria is created by Re-Logic; tModLoader is developed by the tModLoader team and community contributors. Thank you to the accessibility testers and players whose feedback shapes Ariadne.

## Prism speech and braille integration

Ariadne includes **Prism 0.17.3 by ethindp and the Prism contributors**, the Platform-agnostic Reader Interface for Speech and Messages, under the **Mozilla Public License 2.0 (MPL-2.0)**.

The Windows x64 dynamic-release `prism.dll` is redistributed **unchanged** from the [upstream release](https://github.com/ethindp/prism/releases/tag/v0.17.3). Its SHA-256 is `99A73CD24AC777EDE4A5742E62CC3615EC7F5722862C0D9B5E4B3672DCF46CC4`.

**Corresponding Prism source is available under MPL-2.0**, at no charge:

- [Browse the exact v0.17.3 source](https://github.com/ethindp/prism/tree/v0.17.3).
- [Download the v0.17.3 source archive](https://github.com/ethindp/prism/archive/refs/tags/v0.17.3.zip).
- Build instructions and dependency declarations are in that source tree. Ariadne makes no changes to Prism.

The [full MPL-2.0 text](Prism/LICENSES/prism/mpl-2.0.txt), [unaltered upstream NOTICE](Prism/NOTICE), and upstream dependency license directory are included in the `.tmod` and in the release's optional documentation-and-licenses ZIP. These notices preserve your rights to the covered software and source; they do not assign Prism's license to unrelated Ariadne files. Mozilla's [distribution FAQ](https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/MPL/2.0/FAQ/) explains source-availability notices for distributed libraries.

## Game content

Terraria and its assets belong to their respective owners. Ariadne reads native cursor sounds from the player's installed Terraria content; no extracted game audio or decompiled game source is included in the release. Ariadne's procedural cues are generated by the mod. This project is not an official Re-Logic, tModLoader, or Prism release.
